title: Orthodontic Benefit Riders: Transfer Entries When a Case Moves to a New Orthodontist
content:
**Orthodontic Benefit Riders — changing orthodontist during treatment.** When an orthodontic case moves to a new orthodontist, Cascade fixes on the transfer entry of the case the fee it recognises for the remaining treatment, and that recognised remaining-treatment fee is what the rest of the case benefit is measured against at the new practice.

## What a transfer entry records

The move is recorded as a transfer entry on the open case. The case keeps its case number, rider, case origin, appliance type and banding date. From the moment the move is recorded, the case shows:

- the new practice's participation agreement, or none;
- the new practice's network status;
- the revised treatment plan;
- the new practice's fee for the remaining treatment;
- the fee Cascade recognises for that remaining treatment.

The transfer entry is dated the day the move is recorded. Nothing is paid by recording the move.

## Who carries it out

Moving the case is the subscriber's own act. The agent unlocks the tool `move_ortho_case_49ae8ecf` and hands it over, and the customer themselves (the subscriber) runs it.

## Parameters of `move_ortho_case_49ae8ecf`

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ortho_rider_id` | reference number of the patient's orthodontic rider the case is paid under, as returned by the orthodontic rider lookup for the subscriber | identifier |
| `ortho_case_event_id` | reference number of the establishment entry of the orthodontic case being moved, as returned by the orthodontic case lookup for the patient's rider | identifier |
| `provider_agreement_id` | reference number of the new orthodontist's participation agreement, as returned by the provider agreement lookup for that practice; an empty string when the new orthodontist holds no Cascade agreement | identifier or empty string |
| `network_status` | network status of the new orthodontist on the day of the move | `in_network` or `out_of_network` |
| `treatment_months` | revised total planned months of active treatment counted from the original banding date, as stated on the new orthodontist's treatment plan | whole number of months |
| `months_remaining` | planned months of active treatment still to come on the day of the move, as stated on the new orthodontist's treatment plan | whole number of months |
| `total_case_fee` | the new orthodontist's fee for the remaining treatment, as stated on that practice's treatment plan | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `allowed_case_fee` | the fee Cascade recognises for the remaining treatment | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; stored as given |

The two `network_status` values mean:

- `in_network`: the new orthodontist holds a Cascade PPO or Premier participating agreement in force on that day, with the orthodontist specialty.
- `out_of_network`: the new orthodontist holds no such agreement in force on that day.

## Receipt

A successful call returns the reference of the new transfer entry (`transfer_entry`), together with:

- the unchanged case number;
- the network status recorded;
- the months remaining as recorded;
- the recognised fee as recorded (USD, 2 decimal places);
- the date of the move.

A receipt carrying a transfer-entry reference means the case now shows the new practice.

### Questions on the transfer entry

**Does recording the move pay the new practice?** No. The transfer entry changes what the case shows, and no payment is made by it.

**What date does the transfer entry carry?** The date on which the subscriber records the move.
